words.sentence: A butterfly has got beautiful wings.
words.def: This insect has got four big, colourful wings. It flies from flower to flower.

words.sentence: The eagle is flying high in the sky.
words.def: This big bird can see very well and flies high in the sky.

words.sentence: Dinosaurs lived a very long time ago.
words.def: These very big animals lived a very long time ago.

words.sentence: A ladybird is a small insect.
words.def: A ladybird or an ant is this. It is a small animal with six legs.

words.sentence: An octopus has got eight legs.
words.def: This sea animal has got eight long legs.

words.sentence: The tortoise is old and very slow.
words.def: This slow animal has got a hard shell on its back.
